title: rpath CUDA trace notes
content:
Notes / breadcrumb journal: investigating intermittent GPU OOMs + symbol errors when launching model server inside k8s pod. Focus: rpath / runpath and mixed driver/libcuda installs across nodes and base images.

Summary of observed symptoms:
- Container sometimes fails to start model process with a crash citing missing symbol / undefined reference at dlopen time (runtime only, not build). Example: 'undefined symbol: cuInit' or 'libcuda.so.1: version `CUDA_11.8' not found'.
- Intermittent OOMs shortly after startup on some nodes (predictable on each run on node A, not reproducible on node B).
- Behavior changes if LD_LIBRARY_PATH or LD_PRELOAD is set in the pod spec.

Environment snapshot (node & image):
- Host driver: nvidia-driver 525.85.12, kernel 6.1.45 (node-a)
- Host driver: 510.x (node-b)
- Container base image: ubuntu:22.04 + cuDNN/CUDA libs packaged in /opt/cuda-12.1/ and symlinked to /usr/local/cuda -> 12.1
- Some images still ship a vendored libcuda.so under /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ (from earlier packaging)

Commands I ran (timestamps included):
- nvidia-smi (inside container) -> shows driver mismatch on node-a: "NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module 525.85.12" then processes ok.
- ldd /app/bin/model-server | grep cuda  (2026-03-01 14:03)
  -> libcudart.so.12 => /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so.12 (0x...)
  -> libcuda.so.1 => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 (0x...)

- readelf -d /app/bin/model-server | egrep 'RUNPATH|RPATH'
  -> 0x000000000000000f (RUNPATH) Library runpath: [/opt/cuda-12.1/lib64:/usr/local/lib]

- LD_DEBUG=libs ./model-server 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p'  (captured 2026-03-02)
  -> searching for libcuda.so.1: found /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 -> opening file -> ELFCLASS64 ...
  -> needed symbol: cuInit -> version CUDA_11.8 -> symbol not found in /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 -> fallback attempt -> dlopen error: "undefined symbol: cuInit"

- strings /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 | grep -E 'CUDA_|NVRM'  -> shows some versioning tags (older compat shim).

- Container chroot test: renamed /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 to libcuda.so.1.bak, set LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/cuda-12.1/lib64, restarted model-server -> server starts reliably on node-a for multiple runs (heap/OOMs stopped).

- strace -f -e openat ./model-server  (to confirm which lib is opened) -> confirmed openat("/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1", O_RDONLY) happens before LD_LIBRARY_PATH is checked for RPATH precedence reasons. (Need to re-check order semantics but logs indicate loader picks the first match.)

Kernel/dmesg excerpts (node-a):
- [ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (GPU 0000:3b:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
- dmesg shows repeated GPU resets around the same time processes OOM. Could be driver+userlib mismatch causing instability under load.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Vendored older libcuda.so in image or on host is being picked up due to DT_RUNPATH or linker search order; library is incompatible with kernel driver -> symbol mismatch + instability.
2) Some nodes have older kernel driver; our container expects newer CUDA ABI; fallback shim triggers partial functionality that leads to memory accounting errors and OOMs under load.
3) LD_PRELOAD or LD_LIBRARY_PATH presence in environment causes different behavior (observed toggles). Some startup scripts set LD_PRELOAD to preload a shim for profiling; that shim isn't compatible across driver versions.
4) Model server uses dlopen with RTLD_DEEPBIND or RTLD_GLOBAL which changes symbol resolution order and can expose unresolved symbols at different times, making crash intermittent.

What I changed / short experiments: 
- Removed vendored libcuda.so from image (renamed during runtime) and forced LD_LIBRARY_PATH to /opt/cuda-12.1/lib64 -> success on node-a.
- On node-b (older driver) tried to force use of host libcuda via bind-mount -> got 'CUDART_VERSION mismatch' warnings and non-fatal errors but server still ran — suggests partial compatibility.
- Built tiny repro (binary that dlopen libcuda.so and looks up cuInit) and ran on both nodes: on node-a failing with original vendored so, on node-b OK only when host lib used.

Notes on rpath/runpath behavior that matter here: 
- DT_RPATH is ignored when DT_RUNPATH exists; RUNPATH is searched after LD_LIBRARY_PATH but before default system paths? Need to re-verify exact order per glibc 2.35 behavior.
- If binary has RUNPATH that points to /opt/cuda-12.1/lib64 but a symlink or file exists earlier in ld.so.cache or /usr/lib, loader may still pick the earlier entry depending on file name identical resolution. Also ldconfig caches may cause stale entries across image layers.

Repro steps to try (next):
- Add debug image that prints: ldconfig -p | grep libcuda && echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH && readelf -d /app/bin/model-server | egrep 'RUNPATH|RPATH' && LD_DEBUG=libs ./model-server |& tee /tmp/lddebug.txt. Ship to node-a and node-b, collect diffs.
- Reproduce with minimal repro binary inside same container to isolate dlopen vs static link issues.
- Try running with env "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/cuda-12.1/lib64:/usr/local/lib" and with /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 moved aside, attempt workload. 
- If reproduces, create k8s admission hook or initContainer that asserts /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.* is not present in image or bind-mounted in an incompatible version.
- Evaluate performing a small wrapper that uses dlopen with RTLD_NOW to surface missing symbols early (so we fail fast in pod startup rather than later).

Potential mitigations / quick wins: 
- Ensure container images do not ship libcuda.* (only ship libcudart, cuBLAS if static). Rely on host driver for libcuda. Document this as "no libcuda in image" policy.
- Add a startup probe that checks cudaGetDeviceCount()/cuInit() and fails startup if symbol mismatch occurs. This avoids silent OOMs.
- Add image-level test in CI that runs model-server in multiple simulated driver versions (docker --gpus) to catch ABI mismatches.

Open questions / TODOs: 
- Confirm exact search order for RUNPATH vs LD_LIBRARY_PATH vs ldconfig cache on our distro (Ubuntu 22.04 with glibc 2.35). (Action: confirm with man ld.so and small C test that prints dlopen resolved path.)
- Are any of our build pipelines or packaging steps bundling libcuda inadvertently? Grep build artifacts for libcuda.so.* (ACTION: run across dockerfiles and debs).
- Check operator configs for LD_PRELOAD usage (profilers, leak detectors) and audit those shims for compatibility.

Quick commands to copy/paste for next run:
- On host: sudo ldconfig -p | grep libcuda || true
- Inside container: readelf -d /app/bin/model-server | egrep 'RUNPATH|RPATH' || true
- Debug runner: docker run --rm --gpus all -e LD_DEBUG=libs my-image /app/bin/model-server 2>&1 | tee /tmp/lddbg.txt

Attachments / snippets: (paste)
- Example LD_DEBUG output fragment: 
  "search cache=/etc/ld.so.cache
   search path=/opt/cuda-12.1/lib64:/usr/local/lib:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
   trying file=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1
   opened file=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1
   calling init: symbol lookup error: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1: undefined symbol: cuInit"

- Example dmesg excerpt: "NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00 has fallen off the bus - GPU reset"

Who to loop in: Samir for runtime/dlopen semantics, Maya for image packaging, infra/SRE for node driver inventory.

Decisions to make: enforce "no libcuda in image" and add early-start GPU API check in model-server startup path.

Log: saved a copy of the LD_DEBUG logs to /tmp/repro/lddebug-node-a-20260302.txt on my laptop. Will upload to GH issue when reproducer is clean.

Notes to future me: keep this note short and move polished action items to Confluence page under product/hosting/driver-compat. This doc is the scratchpad for the incident and experiments.
